# Template files

You can use these files as boilterplates for filters and transitions.

Put these files in your additional effect folder (if you didn't configure one yet, open Shadertastic Settings in OBS: `Tools > Shadertastic Settings`)

You must follow this folder structure:
```
- [my/additionnal/folder]
  - filters
    - my_filter
  - transitions
    - my_transition
```

Put the content of the templates in the `my_filter` and/or `my_transition` folder.
